notes.title: Runeyana was accidentally released as a full release.
notes.content: We would like to apologize ourselves to the people who bought Runeyana with the belief that it was a fully released game. We accidentally launched it as the full version without being finished yet. However, thanks to Valve's support, Runeyana is back to Early Access. The game is still unfinished and lot of content will be added before the final release. We have read all your reviews and we will fix all the issues within the game and we will even add more features. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Important notice to the fans of the game, and for those people who bought Runeyana from the Steam store.
notes.content:
Important notice to the fans of the game, and for those people who bought Runeyana from the Steam store. 

Our team is planning to release the Runeyana expansion missions pack. At the moment when the package will be released, Runeyana will be available on discount and price will decrease and the people who actually bought Runeyana from the Steam store will get the package for free.

How we will know that you really bought the game from the store? 
The best way to do it is to leave your review on Runeyana main page. Steam filters all reviews by steam purchases filter. Then we will be able to detect your real purchases on steam!

After the release of the package we will no longer detect that.
